sections.content: CSS anchor positioning places tooltips, popovers, and menus relative to a trigger element — pure CSS, no JS measuring.
Set position-anchor on the positioned element, anchor-name on the trigger, then use anchor() and position-area/position-try for placement with automatic flipping when space runs out.
Key points: solves the "tooltip goes off-screen" problem declaratively, pairs with popover API, and fallback positioning still needs care in older browsers.
